title: Detailed headphones
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Headband outer -->
  <path d='M18 55 Q18 15 50 15 Q82 15 82 55' fill='none' stroke='#4A90D9' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Headband inner highlight -->
  <path d='M22 55 Q22 20 50 20 Q78 20 78 55' fill='none' stroke='#7BC4F0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Padding on headband -->
  <path d='M30 22 Q50 16 70 22' fill='none' stroke='#F0A030' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Left ear cup outer -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='62' rx='16' ry='20' fill='#E84A5F'/>
  <!-- Left ear cup inner -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='62' rx='11' ry='15' fill='#FF8C99'/>
  <!-- Left ear cup cushion -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='62' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <!-- Right ear cup outer -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='62' rx='16' ry='20' fill='#E84A5F'/>
  <!-- Right ear cup inner -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='62' rx='11' ry='15' fill='#FF8C99'/>
  <!-- Right ear cup cushion -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='62' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <!-- Left ear cup highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='56' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#FFB3BA' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Right ear cup highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='56' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#FFB3BA' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Left arm connecting to cup -->
  <rect x='30' y='58' width='8' height='8' rx='3' fill='#4A90D9'/>
  <!-- Right arm connecting to cup -->
  <rect x='62' y='58' width='8' height='8' rx='3' fill='#4A90D9'/>
  <!-- Left ear cup small detail -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='62' r='3' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Right ear cup small detail -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='62' r='3' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Left ear cup screw dots -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='55' r='2' fill='#A03040'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='69' r='2' fill='#A03040'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='55' r='2' fill='#A03040'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='69' r='2' fill='#A03040'/>
  <!-- Right ear cup screw dots -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='55' r='2' fill='#A03040'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='69' r='2' fill='#A03040'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='55' r='2' fill='#A03040'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='69' r='2' fill='#A03040'/>
  <!-- Headband top cushion highlight -->
  <path d='M35 20 Q50 15 65 20' fill='none' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
